title: How to reset MFA when a phone is lost or replaced
body:
When to use this

A user has lost their phone, replaced it, or wiped it, and can no longer approve sign-in requests.

Steps

  1. Confirm the caller's identity against two pieces of information held in the HR record.
  2. In the admin centre, open the user and choose Require re-register MFA.
  3. Ask the user to sign in on a desktop and follow the enrolment prompt.
  4. Confirm a successful sign-in from the new device before closing the ticket.

Do not

Do not disable MFA to "get them working" - raise a temporary access pass instead.

title: Outlook keeps asking for a password
body:
Cause

Nearly always cached credentials after a policy change, or a legacy connector still in scope.

Fix

  1. Close Outlook.
  2. Remove the stored entries under Credential Manager > Windows Credentials.
  3. Reopen Outlook and sign in fully.
  4. If it recurs within a day, check whether the device is compliant.

title: Warehouse scanner loses its WMS session
body:
Known error

AP firmware does not honour fast roam (vendor ref WX-4471).

Workaround

Pin the affected aisle to a single AP channel. Firmware 9.4 fixes it and is scheduled.

title: Depot WAN link troubleshooting
body:
First checks

  1. Confirm whether both depots are affected - if so it is upstream.
  2. Check the router interface for CRC errors.
  3. Fail over to the bonded 4G profile.
  4. Raise with Calderstone quoting the circuit ID and the error counters.

title: Recovering a deleted file or folder
body:
Options in order

  1. Previous Versions on the share.
  2. The share's recycle bin (30 days).
  3. Offsite backup restore - raise a ticket, 4 hour response.

Always confirm the exact path and a date to restore from.

title: Reporting a suspicious or phishing email
body:
Do this

  1. Use the Report Phishing button - do not forward it.
  2. If you clicked a link or entered credentials, tell the service desk immediately and change your password.

Reporting a genuine email by mistake causes no harm. Reporting nothing does.

title: Printing to an MFD after the 3.18 firmware update
body:
Symptom

Queues fail with error 0x0000011b after the vendor firmware push.

Fix

Recreate the queue as IPP rather than RAW. Existing RAW queues cannot be repaired in place.

title: Requesting software (including Adobe and Sage)
body:
Process

  1. Raise a service request naming the software and business reason.
  2. Licence availability is checked against the compliance view.
  3. If none is spare, a purchase is raised with the licence reseller - allow ten working days.
